backend/main.mo: Minimal Motoko canister actor with no methods.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence describing quiz Q6 multi-correct update referencing quizData.ts.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file containing prewritten summaries for all frontend source files.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base plus CSS variables defining light/dark theme color tokens using OKLCH values.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry point mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component controlling navigation between all quiz and result screens with themed layout and audio/toast support.
frontend/src/components/CelebrationBurst: Animation component generating falling heart/sparkle particles, supporting continuous or timed bursts.
frontend/src/components/FloatingHeartsBa: Generates 15 animated floating heart elements for a decorative background.
frontend/src/components/SparkleBurst.tsx: Creates a radial burst of sparkles and stars for special celebration effects.
frontend/src/features/audio/AudioControl: Audio toggle button that enables or disables app audio via useAudio.
frontend/src/features/audio/useAudio.ts: Hook managing audio enable state and background music playback.
frontend/src/features/quiz/quizData.ts: Defines quiz questions and options, including Q6 marking both "Ronaldo" and "You" as correct.
frontend/src/features/quiz/useQuiz.ts: Hook handling quiz progression, scoring, and answer selection timing.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches authenticated or anonymous backend actors, refreshing when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements a React context and provider for Internet Identity authentication, handling creation, loading, login, and state of AuthClient identities.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles, custom color variables, gradients, animations, and utility classes for the app’s romantic theme.
frontend/src/lib/copyLink.ts: Provides a function to copy the current page URL to the clipboard with a fallback for older browsers.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, wrapping it with React Query and the Internet Identity provider.
frontend/src/screens/FinalCelebrationScr: Displays the final celebration screen with heart animations, a congratulatory message, and a restart button.
frontend/src/screens/PunishmentScreen.ts: Shows a themed punishment message with decorative UI and a continue button.
frontend/src/screens/QuizScreen.tsx: Renders the quiz interface with progress tracking, answer handling, and celebratory effects for correct answers.
frontend/src/screens/ResultsPerfectScree: Shows the perfect-score results screen with celebrations, a redeemable date coupon, sharing functionality, and restart controls.
Displays a teasing results screen showing the user’s score, a meme image, and buttons to continue, share, or restart.
frontend/src/screens/ValentineQuestionSc: Shows a yes/no Valentine prompt where the 'Yes' button grows and the 'No' button shrinks based on user interaction.
frontend/src/screens/WelcomeScreen.tsx: Renders a welcome screen with a themed title, start button, and share link functionality.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, animations, container settings, and plugins.
project_state.json: Stores project metadata, feature summaries, known issues, and architectural notes for the Valentine quiz app.
